messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a public holiday (or its observed day) plus the adjacent Saturday and/or Sunday.  The table shows the holiday, the province(s) that observe it (if it’s not nationwide), the actual holiday date, the observed date (if the holiday fell on a weekend), and the full long‑weekend window.

| # | Holiday | Province(s) (nationwide if all) | Holiday Date | Observed Date | Long‑Weekend Window |
|---|---------|---------------------------------|--------------|---------------|---------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Nationwide | 1 Jan 2023 (Sunday) | 2 Jan 2023 (Mon) | 1 Jan – 2 Jan |
| 2 | Family Day | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island | 20 Feb 2023 (Mon) | – | 18 Feb – 20 Feb |
| 3 | Good Friday | Nationwide | 10 Mar 2023 (Fri) | – | 10 Mar – 12 Mar |
| 4 | Victoria Day | Nationwide | 22 May 2023 (Mon) | – | 20 May – 22 May |
| 5 | Canada Day | Nationwide | 1 Jul 2023 (Sat) | 3 Jul 2023 (Mon) | 1 Jul – 3 Jul |
| 6 | Labour Day | Nationwide | 4 Sep 2023 (Mon) | – | 2 Sep – 4 Sep |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Nationwide | 9 Oct 2023 (Mon) | – | 7 Oct – 9 Oct |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nationwide | 11 Nov 2023 (Sat) | 13 Nov 2023 (Mon) | 11 Nov – 13 Nov |
| 9 | Christmas Day | Nationwide | 25 Dec 2023 (Mon) | – | 23 Dec – 25 Dec |

### Notes & Caveats

1. **Family Day** is *not* a federal holiday; it is observed in the provinces listed above.  If you’re targeting a specific province, adjust accordingly.
2. **Remembrance Day** is a statutory holiday in most provinces, but some (e.g., British Columbia) observe it on the nearest weekday if it falls on a weekend.  In 2023, BC observed it on Monday 13 Nov, creating the same long‑weekend window.
3. **Boxing Day** (26 Dec 2023) fell on a Tuesday, so it did not create a long weekend.
4. **Other provincial holidays** (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.) are not listed because they do not create a three‑day weekend in 2023.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app.  If you need province‑specific long weekends beyond the ones listed, let me know!

Also some holidays that are observed on nearest weekday if they fall on weekend. But long weekends: New Year's Day (if Jan 1 is Sunday, observed Monday Jan 2). In 2023, Jan 1 is Sunday, so observed Monday Jan 2. That creates long weekend Jan 1-3? But here it's Sunday and Monday. But we can list.

Family Day: in many provinces on third Monday in February. In 2023, Family Day in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc. That is Monday Feb 20. So long weekend Feb 18-20? Actually weekend Feb 18-19 plus Monday Feb 20. So long weekend.

Good Friday: Friday Mar 10. So long weekend Mar 10-12? Actually Friday Mar 10, Saturday Mar 11, Sunday Mar 12. So long weekend.

Victoria Day: Monday May 22 (since 2023). So long weekend May 20-22.
